title: SpatialScout-V2: Can VLM Agents Actively Explore Real-World 3D Scenes and Localize Objects?
title_zh: SpatialScout-V2：VLM 智能体能否主动探索真实三维场景并定位物体？
abstract_en: Spatial intelligence requires agents to acquire visual evidence and integrate partial observations into coherent three-dimensional representations. We introduce SpatialScout-V2, which extends SpatialScout's active mapping task from simulation to real residential scenes through three advances: real visual observations, preservation of original scene content, and interactive exploration of recorded views. Built from 100 homes in Realsee3D, the benchmark covers 3,171 target objects across 29 categories. Given a fixed target inventory, agents autonomously select recorded viewpoints and viewing directions, integrate calibrated RGB observations, and iteratively estimate and revise object centers within a fixed interaction budget. We evaluate the localization accuracy and completeness of object-center maps using mean IoU, IoU-threshold hit rates, and target coverage. Evaluating seven frontier vision-language models (VLMs), we find that six achieve an all-target mean IoU below 20\%. Even the best-performing model, Claude Opus 5.5, reaches only 22.52\%, with just 18.36\% of targets exceeding an IoU of 0.5. Further analysis shows that broad submission coverage can coexist with limited localization accuracy, while target omissions further reduce overall scores. These results highlight substantial challenges in constructing accurate and complete object-center maps through active exploration of real scenes.
abstract_zh: 空间智能要求智能体主动获取视觉证据，并将局部观测整合为一致的三维表征。SpatialScout-V2 将 SpatialScout 的主动建图任务从仿真扩展到真实住宅场景：使用真实视觉观测，保留原始场景内容，并允许智能体交互式探索预先采集的视图。该基准基于 Realsee3D 的 100 套住宅，包含 29 类共 3,171 个目标物体。给定固定的目标清单，智能体须在有限的交互预算内自主选择观测位置和朝向，融合经过标定的 RGB 观测，迭代估计并修正物体中心位置。评测采用平均交并比（IoU）、IoU 阈值命中率和目标覆盖率，衡量物体中心地图的定位精度与完整性。受测的 7 个前沿视觉语言模型（VLM）中，6 个在全部目标上的平均 IoU 低于 20%；表现最好的 Claude Opus 5.5 也仅达到 22.52%，且只有 18.36% 的目标 IoU 超过 0.5。进一步分析表明，高覆盖率并不意味着定位准确，而漏报会进一步拉低总体得分。结果显示，现有 VLM 仍难以通过主动探索构建既准确又完整的物体中心地图。
key_points_zh: SpatialScout-V2 使用 Realsee3D 中 100 套真实住宅的预采集视图，覆盖 29 类、3,171 个目标物体。
智能体不是被动接收固定图像，而是在交互预算内自主选择观测位置和朝向，并根据新观测修正三维物体中心估计。
7 个受测 VLM 中有 6 个在全部目标上的平均 IoU 低于 20%；最佳模型 Claude Opus 5.5 也只有 18.36% 的目标 IoU 超过 0.5。
目标覆盖率与定位精度需要分开衡量：提交更多目标不代表定位更准，漏报则会进一步降低总体得分。
